extends.description: Id of the package this one inherits from.

abstract.description: Only for inheriting from: not playable, and not checked as a complete fighter. Not inherited.

tagline.description: One-line pitch on the character select card.

charges.description: Limited-use resources (weapons, tomes). Moves reference them by id for variants, costs and gates.

hurtRegions.description: Nonempty regions replace both legacy rectangle groups.

combatCenter.description: Stable feet-relative autolink target; required with hurtRegions.

items.description:
Holdable items, granted by a move event's `item`. Holding one turns attacks into throws (`docs/FORMAT.md`,
Items).

rig.description: Optional named-joint figure. Omit to draw the legacy humanoid skeleton.

poses.description: Named poses, used by `anims`, move phases and other poses (`from`).

anims.description: State animations by name (`idle`, `run`, `air.rise`, `hitstun`…). See `docs/FORMAT.md` for the list.

description:
`fighters/<id>/fighter.json`. With `extends`, the parent's data is merged in first (objects key by key,
arrays replaced whole, `null` removes a key), so every field may come from the parent.
title: Fighter

pummelDamage.description: Override the shared grab pummel damage.

dashSpeed.description: Initial dash speed, held for dashFrames, then easing into the run (default runSpeed × gait.dashSpeed).

walkSpeed.description: Full-tilt walk speed; defaults to runSpeed × gait.walkSpeed.

groundFriction.description: Legacy (no `movement.ultimate`): idle and crouch velocity multiplier per frame.

traction.description: Grounded slowdown in px/frame² with `movement.ultimate` (default its `traction`; Ultimate traction × 5).

jumpSpeed.description: Full hop launch speed (upward). With `jumpInitialHeight` it is the speed after the initial rise.

jumpInitialHeight.description:
Ultimate's jump initial height: a full hop rises this far in equal steps over its first 4 airborne frames
(no gravity), then continues at `jumpSpeed` (derived from the remaining height). Short hops and air jumps
are unaffected. Omit for a plain jump.

airAccel.description:
Air drift acceleration (px/frame²). With `movement.ultimate` it also drives attacks, up specials and helpless
fall, times that movement's per-kind multiplier and the phase `airAccelMult`.

airFriction.description:
Airborne slowdown in px/frame² with `movement.ultimate`: toward zero with the stick neutral, toward airSpeed
when above it (default its `airFriction`; Ultimate air friction × 5).

float.description:
Peach-style float: once per airtime, holding jump while descending (or jump pressed with down held) holds
the vertical speed at `speed` for up to `frames` ticks, through aerials. Omit to disable.

groundHeight.description:
Ground float: leaving jumpsquat with down held (float unused) starts the float at once, lifted this far
above the ground with no vertical speed, instead of a hop. 0 (default) disables it.

Float.description:
`stats.float`. Starts in the air (normal `Air` control) once per airtime when jump is held while not rising,
or on a jump press with down held (from the ground too, with `groundHeight`). While it lasts the fighter's vertical speed is `speed` (0 = hover; positive
sinks) and drift, aerials and the air jump work as usual; an aerial started during the float keeps it.
Releasing jump, the frame limit, an air jump, fast fall, being hit, a ledge, any non-aerial state and landing end
it; landing (not a ledge) makes it available again.

recharge.description: Ticks from empty back to full. Zero keeps it spent until respawn.

discardDelay.description: Ticks after using the pool's last charge before its refill starts (a tome is thrown away first).

ChargePool.description: A charge resource (a weapon, tome or other limited-use tool) and its recharge behavior.

Hurtboxes.description: Hurtboxes for the default and knockdown state groups.

Rect.description: Axis-aligned box in fighter-local space (x forward, y up from the feet).

enabled.description: Default activation. State selectors override this; phase windows override selectors.

states.description: Typed state overrides. Crouch overrides idle while grounded in the crouch gait.

BoundPoint.description: Feet-relative forward/up, or a named joint's rotated local space.

reach.description: How close the CPU wants to be to attack.

counterChance.description: Chance to counter instead of shielding; zero skips the RNG call.

recoveryShieldCancel.description: Recovery behavior is enabled by move air control, with this optional shield-cancel phase.

specials.description: Ordered special tactics; chance is sampled only after all geometric conditions pass.

minDistance.description: Strict lower bound on horizontal target distance.

maxDistance.description: Optional strict upper bound on horizontal target distance.

height.description: Strict upper bound on absolute vertical target separation.

grounded.description: Require the CPU to be grounded.

chance.description: Success probability, sampled after geometry and ownership checks pass.

neutral.description:
Grounded idle without hitlag only: face the target and clear stick directions to select neutral
instead of side special (or down special with `down`).

down.description: Add down to the toward-target special input.

hold.description: Optional special-button hold duration range; sampled then floored.

Moves.description: Move slots. Specials are chosen by input direction; without `sspec`, side + special does `nspec`.

name.description: Name shown in the debug overlay and training panel.

bReverse.description:
Pressing the other direction within `global.movement.bReverseWindow` frames turns the fighter around
(and flips air momentum).

oncePerAirtime.description: May start once before landing (being hit does not restore it).

chargeDamage.description: Damage bonus per held charge tick. Omit to use the global smash-charge divisor.

variants.description:
Alternate timelines picked once when the move starts, by the fighter's charge resources (a weapon or tome
with uses left). The first variant whose `needs` is satisfied wins; otherwise `phases` runs.

phases.description: Runs from the first phase. A move must have at least one phase.

oneOf.description: `attackAirAccel` (`ultimate.attackAirAccelMult` × airAccel).
`aerialAccel` (`ultimate.aerialAccelMult` × airAccel), and the move can fast-fall.
`upSpecialAccel` (`ultimate.upSpecialAccelMult` × airAccel).

AirControl.description: Which global air acceleration a move uses while airborne (`global.movement`).

needs.description: The charge resource that must still have uses for this variant to be picked.

MoveVariant.description: An alternate phase timeline, chosen at move start by a charge resource.

ChargeNeed.description: A charge requirement: a resource id and how many uses it takes.

hurtRegions.description: Inclusive phase-tick activation overrides of named fighter hurt regions.

aim.description:
This phase still accepts the move's single `bReverse` turnaround (a charged move can aim after the
shared opening window).

name.description: Unique within the move. Transitions refer to it. `end`, `helpless` and `landing` are reserved.

frames.description: Phase length (see the frame convention). Omit for a phase that loops until a transition fires.

chargeFrames.description: Extra phase frames per stored charge tick (rounded to the nearest whole frame).

cost.description:
Spent from the fighter's charge resources when the phase is entered. A pool with fewer uses left than
this spends what remains (and starts recharging); the phase still runs.

transitions.description:
Checked in order; the first that fires wins. A phase with `frames` and no `timeout` transition ends the
move when it times out.

charge.description: Hold to charge (smash attacks, chargeable specials).

groundSpeed.description: Grounded: horizontal stick speed while retaining the move and its facing.

counter.description: Counter stance: hits received during the window are countered.

reflector.description: Reflect projectiles throughout this window without interrupting the move.

travelSpeed.description: Constant-speed directional travel, aimed once on phase entry; neutral aims upward.

hidden.description: Hide the figure during teleport travel; collision and invulnerability remain separate.

armorThreshold.description:
Hits dealing at most this damage preserve the phase and velocity (damage and hitlag still apply).
Grabs bypass armor. Omit for normal hit reactions.

hover.description: Airborne: vertical speed is held at 0 (hovering startup).

fallCap.description: Airborne: max fall speed during this phase (default: the fighter's fall speed or fast-fall speed).

airAccelMult.description:
Multiplies the move's air acceleration (0 = no drift control): with `movement.ultimate` that is the fighter's
airAccel × the `air` kind's multiplier, otherwise the shared legacy accel.

detection.description: Fighter-local rectangle that detects a hittable opponent for `targetNear` transitions.

slide.description:
Grounded: phase frames below this use `attackSlideFriction` instead of `attackFriction` (dash attacks), or
traction × `attackSlideTraction` with `movement.ultimate`.

ledgeGrab.description: Can grab a ledge (even while rising) from this phase frame on.

tether.description: Extended forward ledge reach while this phase's ledgeGrab window is open.

passPlatforms.description: Pass through semisolid platforms throughout this phase.

anim.description: Body pose keyframes, in phase frames.

attach.description: Attachment animation by attachment id (weapon swings, held props).

Phase.description:
One step of a move.

Frame convention: a phase's frame 0 is the tick it's entered (the move's first phase is entered on the tick
the move starts). Each later tick advances the phase frame by 1, runs that frame's `events`, then checks
`transitions`. With `frames: N`, the phase ends on its frame N: the next phase's frame 0 is that same tick.
A single-phase move with `frames: N` therefore matches the old "last active frame + endLag" total N.

region.description: Stable hurtRegions ID; deleting a referenced region is a validation error.

from.description: Inclusive current phase MoveState.t, independent of elapsed move time.

end.description: Last active phase frame (inclusive). Omit to stay active until the phase ends.

x.description: Offset forward from the feet. Negative = behind.

bkb.description:
Base knockback in reference units (converted by global.knockback.ultimate.launchSpeed).
Windboxes use this as pixel-space force instead.

kbg.description: Knockback growth as a fraction (100% reference growth = 1).

angle.description: Launch angle in degrees. 0 = forward, 90 = straight up, negative = down.

groundAngle.description: Optional launch angle for grounded victims (before the shared ground-bounce rule).

situation.description: Grounded, airborne, or either kind of victim. Also applies to projectile contact hits.

setKb.description: Fixed knockback: ignores damage/percent (launch speed = bkb × launchSpeed × victim weight multiplier).

fkb.description:
Ultimate's weight-based fixed knockback (FKB/WBKB): the shared formula with percent 10 and this value as the
damage, ignoring the victim's percent and the hit's damage; `bkb` and `kbg` keep their source meaning. Needs
`knockback.ultimate`; takes precedence over `setKb`.

rehit.description: Multi-hit: can hit the same victim/group again every this many move ticks (default: once until history clears).

group.description:
Independent hit identity within one move. A victim can be hit once per group, so later rows with the
same group are alternatives (early/late tiers, coverage changes) while a different group is a new hit
(multi-hit sequences such as Diddy Kong's forward smash).

hitstunMult.description: Multiplies the hitstun this box causes.

counterDamage.description: Counter strike: damage comes from the countered hit (see `Counter`). Inactive if nothing was countered.

heal.description:
Fraction of the damage dealt that heals the attacker (Nosferatu drains health). Capped at the
attacker's current damage.

unblockable.description: Ignores shields, counters and parries (a command grab such as Nosferatu still lands on a guarding victim).

minCharge.description: In a move, inactive below this many held charge ticks.

frames.description:
Per-frame position/size `[frame, x, y, r]`. A frame without an entry uses the closest earlier entry, or
x/y/r before the first entry. Omit for a box that stays put.

geometry.description: Explicit collision replaces static x/y/r; cannot combine with frames.

Hitbox.description:
A hit circle. In a move phase, `start`/`end` are inclusive phase frames. For throws, projectiles and other
hits that aren't frame-windowed they are ignored. When two boxes overlap a victim, the first listed wins.

oneOf.description: The way the attacker faces.
Away from the attacker's center (multi-direction hits).
Behind the attacker.
Always launches downward (a positive `angle` is mirrored below the horizon).
Grounded victims are knocked prone instead of launched. Airborne victims are hit normally.
Angle chosen automatically: flat on weak grounded hits, higher on strong ones, 45° in the air (`global.hitTypes.sakurai`).
Pulls the victim toward the hitbox center, plus the attacker's momentum. For multi-hit moves (`rehit`).
No damage, hitstun or hitlag. Pushes anything it touches every frame along `angle` (strength = bkb).
Longer victim hitlag (`global.hitTypes.electric`), with spark effects.
Freeze in place before launching; cannot paralyze again until actionable or landed.
Trap grounded targets in place; airborne targets launch normally.
Grabs instead of hitting.

Damage and shield damage only: no hitstun, hitlag, launch or state change. Used by lingering
no-flinch hazards such as Poison Breath.

Situation.description: Which victim positions a hitbox can hit.

every.description: Only on world frames divisible by this (alternate-frame particles).

chargeVelocity.description: Scale `setVel` and `addVel` by (1 + held charge ticks × this); never scales `mulVel`.

minCharge.description: Skip this event below this many held charge ticks.

capFall.description: Cap downward speed at this (before gravity is applied this tick).

leaveGround.description: Leave the ground (needed for upward launches from the ground).

invuln.description: Invulnerable for this many frames (keeps the longer of this and any current invulnerability).

spawn.description: Spawn a projectile by id (from the fighter's `projectiles`).

item.description: Put this item (from the fighter's `items`) in its hand; nothing when it already holds one.

restore.description: Restore uses to a charge pool, capped at capacity. Keeps recharge running until full.

detonate.description: Explode owned gadgets matching these projectile ids (including unarmed ones). Empty means all.

Event.description:
Frame-scoped actions. Use `at` for one frame, or `from`/`to` (inclusive) for a range. `from` alone means
from there on; neither means every frame from 1. Actions in one event run in field order (velocity, then
`leaveGround`, `invuln`, `spawn`, `item`, `restore`, `detonate`, `sfx`, `fx`); events on the same frame run in list order.

oneOf.description: The phase was entered by a counter that caught a hit with damage (not a reflected projectile).

Vel.description: Velocity components; a missing component is left alone.

oneOf.description: One particle. `inheritVel` adds the emitter's velocity times this.

Fx.description: Visual effect, positioned in fighter-local space (or projectile-local for projectile trails).

Num.description:
A number, or `[min, max]` for a random value from the world RNG.
Ranges are drawn in field order (x, y, vx, vy, life, size), which matters for determinism.

from.description: Only from this phase frame on.

minCharge.description: Only fires with at least this many held charge ticks (a charged move can pick a phase per tier).

needs.description:
Only fires while this charge resource still has uses (a jab can fall back when its tome is empty).
List the resource-gated transition before its fallback: the first match wins.

preserveHits.description: Keep victim contact history when continuing the same attack in another phase.

Transition.description:
Where a transition goes: another phase by name, or one of the move endings `end` (idle on the ground, air
in the air), `helpless` (idle on the ground, helpless in the air), `landing` (landing lag of `lag` frames).

oneOf.description: The phase reached `frames` (checked after the frame's events).
The fighter landed this tick (fires during movement, after the step).
On the ground when checked in the step.
In the air when checked in the step.
Vertical speed is zero or downward.
The charge button (or attack, without `charge`) isn't held.
Like `release`, and the live movement stick points toward the fighter's facing (a forward throw).
Like `release`, and the live movement stick points away from the fighter's facing (a back throw).
Attack is held (jab follow-ups).
A new attack press; held buttons alone do not retrigger it.
A hittable opponent overlaps the phase's fighter-local `detection` rectangle.
Shield was pressed this tick.
An owned controlled projectile was manually released.
A held projectile ended without being launched (its caster let go or lost control).
A hit was countered in the phase's `counter` window.
A hitbox of this phase connected (hit or shield).

frame.description: Phase frame that freezes while held.

holdAfterMax.description: Additional ticks the button can hold after reaching max; strength stays capped.

jet.description: Jet-engine charge effects (flames behind, jet sound, glowing attachments).

Charge.description:
While the button is held on `frame`, the phase stays on that frame and charge builds.
Charge multiplies the move's damage: × (1 + charge / `global.knockback.chargeDamageDivisor`).

damageMult.description: Counter damage (used by `counterDamage` hitboxes) = max(minDamage, incoming × damageMult).

attackerFreeze.description: Freeze frames for the countered attacker.

reflectSpeed.description: Reflected projectile: speed multiplier and new lifetime.

Counter.description:
Counter window. A hit received in it fires the phase's `counter` transition: the attacker freezes, and
projectiles are reflected.

if.description: Only used while this holds (`grounded` / `airborne` / `countered`); otherwise the key is skipped.

minCharge.description:
Skip this key below this many held charge ticks. Lets a move's reach tier follow its charge without
duplicating phases (the selected pose also moves any joint-bound collision).

AnimKey.description: Pose keyframe. Holds until the next key; with `lerp`, the figure blends from the previous key to this one.

PoseRef.description: A named pose, or an inline (partial) pose.

joints.description:
Local transform overrides for an optional named-joint rig. Missing components inherit from
`from` / `stand`, then the rig's rest transforms. Does not alter combat geometry.

rot.description: Whole-body rotation in degrees, positive = pitching forward, around `(0, pivot)`.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset of the whole figure (up).

Pose.description:
Joint positions in fighter-local space (x forward, y up, feet at the origin). A pose may be partial: missing
joints come from `from` (another named pose), or from the `stand` pose.

translation.description: Replaces the rest translation; it is not an additive offset.

angle.description: Replaces the rest angle. Keep angles unwrapped when animating through a full turn.

`[frame, degrees]`, interpolated without wrapping. Use 350 → 430 to rotate forward through 360° to 70°;
350 → 70 rotates backward by 280°. Keep subsequent keys on the same turn for continuous trails.

offset.description: `[frame, x, y]` offset from the joint.

show.description: Inclusive phase frames a `hidden` attachment is shown.

hide.description: Inclusive phase frames a visible attachment is not shown (a weapon stowed while casting or grabbing).

AttachAnim.description: Attachment animation within a move phase (phase frames). Angle, offset and scale keys interpolate linearly.

release.description: Frame the victim is released and hit.

hit.description: Geometry and window fields are ignored.

ticks.description: Damage-only hits applied to the held victim before release.

spawn.description: Spawn offset from the feet (x forward, y up).

max.description: Max alive per owner. Spawning past it does nothing (plays `fullSfx` if set).

bounce.description: Collides with the stage and bounces. Without it the projectile flies through.

bat.description: Any attack can knock it back, making the attacker its owner.

reflectVy.description: Vertical speed (up) given when reflected by a counter. Omit to keep it.

hit.description: Geometry and window fields are ignored; the hit comes from the projectile's position.

trail.description: Effects emitted while flying (in projectile-local space, x along its travel direction).

chargeScale.description: Per held charge tick, add these fractions to launch speed and damage (1 + ticks × value).

explosion.description: Suppress contact hits until armed, then explode on proximity or lifetime expiry.

article.description: Independently controlled construction / travel followed by a staged attack timeline.

shapes.description: Drawing: `shapes` rotate by `spin` degrees per pixel traveled, `overlay` doesn't rotate.

Projectile.description: A projectile spawned by a move's `spawn` event.

restitution.description: Fraction of fall speed kept on a floor bounce.

friction.description: Horizontal speed multiplier per floor bounce.

maxBounces.description: After this many bounces, life drops to `fizzleLife`.

wallRestitution.description: Horizontal speed kept when hitting the stage's side walls.

speed.description: New horizontal speed (in the hit's launch direction) and vertical speed (up).

cooldown.description: Frames before it can be batted again.

rehit.description: Frames added to `hit.rehit` per held charge tick (rounds at each hit check).

angleTo.description: Launch angle at maximum charge; interpolated from the base hit's angle.

manual.description: Ignore proximity and freeze the fuse; only a detonate event explodes this gadget.

armTicks.description: Ticks before proximity can trigger. Unless manual, the fuse expires at projectile life zero.

proximity.description: Distance to an opponent's hurtbox that triggers; omit for fuse only.

releaseOnUp.description: Release the special button to launch; otherwise a second special press launches.

releaseOnDir.description:
A fresh left/right stick input while still holding special launches the article in that direction;
letting go of special ends it instead (Ptooie's blow-away and swallow).

reflectCooldown.description: Ticks during which any reflector is ignored after reflection.

hold.description: While unreleased, keep the article at this fighter-local point and let it breathe.

steer.description: Vertical speed selected by the live stick during travel, zero for stationary construction.

hurtbox.description: Optional destructible body, relative to the projectile origin.

offset.description: Fighter-local point (x forward, y up) for the article's origin.

period.description: Breathing period in ticks. Required when `bob` is non-zero.

hitboxes.description: Active while the article is held (inclusive `start`/`end` are construction-age ticks).

ArticleHold.description:
Standby placement of a held article. The point follows the caster, so a held ball stays at the mouth
while the fighter moves or turns.

from.description: Select the last stage whose construction age has been reached, frozen at release.

autoStartup.description: Optional shorter windup for automatic release from standby. Hit windows shift by the same amount.

stroke.description: Connect active tracked damaging hitbox centers, following their per-frame tracks (e.g. a summoned blade).

oneOf.description: Four-pointed sparkle. With `blink`, it shows only every other `blink` ticks (world clock).
Rectangle from corner `(x, y)` (the bottom-left in y-up space), with optional rounded corners.

Shape.description: Vector shape. Coordinates are in the owner's local space.

projectile.description:
Projectile (from `projectiles`, with `bounce`) a tilt throw or a drop launches. Its shapes draw the item;
its radius, gravity, fall cap and bounce move the loose item.

hold.description:
Fighter-local point (x forward, y up) a throw starts from; also where the held item is drawn on figures
without a front hand.

speedDamage.description:
Damage added per px/tick of throw speed above the projectile's own `vel` speed (taken away below it),
never below zero. Ultimate's thrown-item damage adds 3 per unit/frame: 0.6 at 5 px per unit.

rebound.description:
Velocity a thrown item bounces off with when its hit connects (x back against its travel, y up). Omit to use
the item up on a hit.

life.description: Ticks a loose item stays in the world.

catch.description: Can be caught out of the air (thrown or falling). A landed item can always be picked up.

Item.description:
A holdable item (`items.<id>`), Smash-style. While it is held, attacks and aerials throw it (the `toss` state);
a thrown item is its `projectile` (smash throws: `smashProjectile`) launched at the throw's velocity. It turns
into a loose world item when it lands, connects or runs out of life, and a loose item can be picked up on the
ground or caught in the air by anyone.

back.description: The fighter turns around first, so x points the new way.

drop.description: Letting go: grab in the air, or attack / grab from shield.

ItemThrows.description: Item throw velocities (x forward, y up) by direction and strength.

Toss.description: Item throw timing, on the `toss` state clock (0 = the tick the throw starts).

glowWidth.description: Soft glow drawn under the limbs.

eye.description: Eye rectangle `[x, y, w, h]` from the head center (x forward, y up, `(x, y)` = bottom-left corner).

Style.description: Drawing style of the stick figure.

joints.description: Declaration order is stable; parents may appear before or after their children.

bones.description: Stick strokes connecting resolved joint positions.

id.description: Unique stable id, used by poses and bindings.

parent.description: Omit for a joint relative to the fighter root. Multiple root joints are allowed.

translation.description: Rest translation in the parent's rotated coordinate system.

angle.description: Rest rotation in degrees, counterclockwise, relative to the parent.

shapes.description: Vector appearance in joint-local space, after local rotation.

loop.description: Repeat every this many clock units.

oneOf.description: Frames since the fighter entered the state.
World frame (idle breathing, wobbles).
Run cycle phase in degrees, advanced by ground speed.
Tumble spin in degrees (signed: follows the launch direction).

Clock.description: Time source for a state animation.

angle.description:
Resting angle in degrees (0 forward, 90 up). On a hand, it's added to the forearm's direction; otherwise
absolute. A phase's `attach` angle keys override it.

hidden.description: Not drawn unless a phase's `attach.show` window says so.

hold.description:
While a phase animates the angle, the front arm is posed to hold it: elbow at `elbow` px along the angle
turned by `bend` degrees, hand at `hand` px, both from the shoulder.

trail.description: Swing trail (ring sector around the shoulder) while a hitbox is active.

sway.description: Idle sway: the angle swings ± `deg` with a period of `period` ticks (world clock).

shapes.description: Shapes in attachment space: x along the angle, y to its left (up when the angle is 0).

Attachment.description: A vector part attached to a joint: weapons, hats, held props.

Joint.description: Fighter joint (or `root` = the feet) an attachment hangs from.

oneOf.description: During a counter window.
While charging a `jet` charge.
While a hitbox is active.

GlowWhen.description: When an attachment glows (shapes with `when: "glow"` replace `when: "noGlow"` ones).

pummelDamage.description: Override the shared grab pummel damage.

dashSpeed.description: Initial dash speed, held for dashFrames, then easing into the run (default runSpeed × gait.dashSpeed).

walkSpeed.description: Full-tilt walk speed; defaults to runSpeed × gait.walkSpeed.

groundFriction.description: Legacy (no `movement.ultimate`): idle and crouch velocity multiplier per frame.

traction.description: Grounded slowdown in px/frame² with `movement.ultimate` (default its `traction`; Ultimate traction × 5).

jumpSpeed.description: Full hop launch speed (upward). With `jumpInitialHeight` it is the speed after the initial rise.

jumpInitialHeight.description:
Ultimate's jump initial height: a full hop rises this far in equal steps over its first 4 airborne frames
(no gravity), then continues at `jumpSpeed` (derived from the remaining height). Short hops and air jumps
are unaffected. Omit for a plain jump.

airAccel.description:
Air drift acceleration (px/frame²). With `movement.ultimate` it also drives attacks, up specials and helpless
fall, times that movement's per-kind multiplier and the phase `airAccelMult`.

airFriction.description:
Airborne slowdown in px/frame² with `movement.ultimate`: toward zero with the stick neutral, toward airSpeed
when above it (default its `airFriction`; Ultimate air friction × 5).

float.description:
Peach-style float: once per airtime, holding jump while descending (or jump pressed with down held) holds
the vertical speed at `speed` for up to `frames` ticks, through aerials. Omit to disable.

groundHeight.description:
Ground float: leaving jumpsquat with down held (float unused) starts the float at once, lifted this far
above the ground with no vertical speed, instead of a hop. 0 (default) disables it.

FloatPartial.description:
`stats.float`. Starts in the air (normal `Air` control) once per airtime when jump is held while not rising,
or on a jump press with down held (from the ground too, with `groundHeight`). While it lasts the fighter's vertical speed is `speed` (0 = hover; positive
sinks) and drift, aerials and the air jump work as usual; an aerial started during the float keeps it.
Releasing jump, the frame limit, an air jump, fast fall, being hit, a ledge, any non-aerial state and landing end
it; landing (not a ledge) makes it available again.

HurtboxesPartial.description: Hurtboxes for the default and knockdown state groups.

RectPartial.description: Axis-aligned box in fighter-local space (x forward, y up from the feet).

reach.description: How close the CPU wants to be to attack.

counterChance.description: Chance to counter instead of shielding; zero skips the RNG call.

recoveryShieldCancel.description: Recovery behavior is enabled by move air control, with this optional shield-cancel phase.

specials.description: Ordered special tactics; chance is sampled only after all geometric conditions pass.

MovesPartial.description: Move slots. Specials are chosen by input direction; without `sspec`, side + special does `nspec`.

name.description: Name shown in the debug overlay and training panel.

bReverse.description:
Pressing the other direction within `global.movement.bReverseWindow` frames turns the fighter around
(and flips air momentum).

oncePerAirtime.description: May start once before landing (being hit does not restore it).

chargeDamage.description: Damage bonus per held charge tick. Omit to use the global smash-charge divisor.

variants.description:
Alternate timelines picked once when the move starts, by the fighter's charge resources (a weapon or tome
with uses left). The first variant whose `needs` is satisfied wins; otherwise `phases` runs.

phases.description: Runs from the first phase. A move must have at least one phase.

oneOf.description: `attackAirAccel` (`ultimate.attackAirAccelMult` × airAccel).
`aerialAccel` (`ultimate.aerialAccelMult` × airAccel), and the move can fast-fall.
`upSpecialAccel` (`ultimate.upSpecialAccelMult` × airAccel).

AirControlPartial.description: Which global air acceleration a move uses while airborne (`global.movement`).

release.description: Frame the victim is released and hit.

hit.description: Geometry and window fields are ignored.

ticks.description: Damage-only hits applied to the held victim before release.

end.description: Last active phase frame (inclusive). Omit to stay active until the phase ends.

x.description: Offset forward from the feet. Negative = behind.

bkb.description:
Base knockback in reference units (converted by global.knockback.ultimate.launchSpeed).
Windboxes use this as pixel-space force instead.

kbg.description: Knockback growth as a fraction (100% reference growth = 1).

angle.description: Launch angle in degrees. 0 = forward, 90 = straight up, negative = down.

groundAngle.description: Optional launch angle for grounded victims (before the shared ground-bounce rule).

situation.description: Grounded, airborne, or either kind of victim. Also applies to projectile contact hits.

setKb.description: Fixed knockback: ignores damage/percent (launch speed = bkb × launchSpeed × victim weight multiplier).

fkb.description:
Ultimate's weight-based fixed knockback (FKB/WBKB): the shared formula with percent 10 and this value as the
damage, ignoring the victim's percent and the hit's damage; `bkb` and `kbg` keep their source meaning. Needs
`knockback.ultimate`; takes precedence over `setKb`.

rehit.description: Multi-hit: can hit the same victim/group again every this many move ticks (default: once until history clears).

group.description:
Independent hit identity within one move. A victim can be hit once per group, so later rows with the
same group are alternatives (early/late tiers, coverage changes) while a different group is a new hit
(multi-hit sequences such as Diddy Kong's forward smash).

hitstunMult.description: Multiplies the hitstun this box causes.

counterDamage.description: Counter strike: damage comes from the countered hit (see `Counter`). Inactive if nothing was countered.

heal.description:
Fraction of the damage dealt that heals the attacker (Nosferatu drains health). Capped at the
attacker's current damage.

unblockable.description: Ignores shields, counters and parries (a command grab such as Nosferatu still lands on a guarding victim).

minCharge.description: In a move, inactive below this many held charge ticks.

frames.description:
Per-frame position/size `[frame, x, y, r]`. A frame without an entry uses the closest earlier entry, or
x/y/r before the first entry. Omit for a box that stays put.

geometry.description: Explicit collision replaces static x/y/r; cannot combine with frames.

HitboxPartial.description:
A hit circle. In a move phase, `start`/`end` are inclusive phase frames. For throws, projectiles and other
hits that aren't frame-windowed they are ignored. When two boxes overlap a victim, the first listed wins.

oneOf.description: The way the attacker faces.
Away from the attacker's center (multi-direction hits).
Behind the attacker.
Always launches downward (a positive `angle` is mirrored below the horizon).
Grounded victims are knocked prone instead of launched. Airborne victims are hit normally.
Angle chosen automatically: flat on weak grounded hits, higher on strong ones, 45° in the air (`global.hitTypes.sakurai`).
Pulls the victim toward the hitbox center, plus the attacker's momentum. For multi-hit moves (`rehit`).
No damage, hitstun or hitlag. Pushes anything it touches every frame along `angle` (strength = bkb).
Longer victim hitlag (`global.hitTypes.electric`), with spark effects.
Freeze in place before launching; cannot paralyze again until actionable or landed.
Trap grounded targets in place; airborne targets launch normally.
Grabs instead of hitting.

Damage and shield damage only: no hitstun, hitlag, launch or state change. Used by lingering
no-flinch hazards such as Poison Breath.

SituationPartial.description: Which victim positions a hitbox can hit.

BoundPointPartial.description: Feet-relative forward/up, or a named joint's rotated local space.

spawn.description: Spawn offset from the feet (x forward, y up).

max.description: Max alive per owner. Spawning past it does nothing (plays `fullSfx` if set).

bounce.description: Collides with the stage and bounces. Without it the projectile flies through.

bat.description: Any attack can knock it back, making the attacker its owner.

reflectVy.description: Vertical speed (up) given when reflected by a counter. Omit to keep it.

hit.description: Geometry and window fields are ignored; the hit comes from the projectile's position.

trail.description: Effects emitted while flying (in projectile-local space, x along its travel direction).

chargeScale.description: Per held charge tick, add these fractions to launch speed and damage (1 + ticks × value).

explosion.description: Suppress contact hits until armed, then explode on proximity or lifetime expiry.

article.description: Independently controlled construction / travel followed by a staged attack timeline.

shapes.description: Drawing: `shapes` rotate by `spin` degrees per pixel traveled, `overlay` doesn't rotate.

ProjectilePartial.description: A projectile spawned by a move's `spawn` event.

restitution.description: Fraction of fall speed kept on a floor bounce.

friction.description: Horizontal speed multiplier per floor bounce.

maxBounces.description: After this many bounces, life drops to `fizzleLife`.

wallRestitution.description: Horizontal speed kept when hitting the stage's side walls.

speed.description: New horizontal speed (in the hit's launch direction) and vertical speed (up).

cooldown.description: Frames before it can be batted again.

rehit.description: Frames added to `hit.rehit` per held charge tick (rounds at each hit check).

angleTo.description: Launch angle at maximum charge; interpolated from the base hit's angle.

manual.description: Ignore proximity and freeze the fuse; only a detonate event explodes this gadget.

armTicks.description: Ticks before proximity can trigger. Unless manual, the fuse expires at projectile life zero.

proximity.description: Distance to an opponent's hurtbox that triggers; omit for fuse only.

releaseOnUp.description: Release the special button to launch; otherwise a second special press launches.

releaseOnDir.description:
A fresh left/right stick input while still holding special launches the article in that direction;
letting go of special ends it instead (Ptooie's blow-away and swallow).

reflectCooldown.description: Ticks during which any reflector is ignored after reflection.

hold.description: While unreleased, keep the article at this fighter-local point and let it breathe.

steer.description: Vertical speed selected by the live stick during travel, zero for stationary construction.

hurtbox.description: Optional destructible body, relative to the projectile origin.

offset.description: Fighter-local point (x forward, y up) for the article's origin.

period.description: Breathing period in ticks. Required when `bob` is non-zero.

hitboxes.description: Active while the article is held (inclusive `start`/`end` are construction-age ticks).

ArticleHoldPartial.description:
Standby placement of a held article. The point follows the caster, so a held ball stays at the mouth
while the fighter moves or turns.

projectile.description:
Projectile (from `projectiles`, with `bounce`) a tilt throw or a drop launches. Its shapes draw the item;
its radius, gravity, fall cap and bounce move the loose item.

hold.description:
Fighter-local point (x forward, y up) a throw starts from; also where the held item is drawn on figures
without a front hand.

speedDamage.description:
Damage added per px/tick of throw speed above the projectile's own `vel` speed (taken away below it),
never below zero. Ultimate's thrown-item damage adds 3 per unit/frame: 0.6 at 5 px per unit.

rebound.description:
Velocity a thrown item bounces off with when its hit connects (x back against its travel, y up). Omit to use
the item up on a hit.

life.description: Ticks a loose item stays in the world.

catch.description: Can be caught out of the air (thrown or falling). A landed item can always be picked up.

ItemPartial.description:
A holdable item (`items.<id>`), Smash-style. While it is held, attacks and aerials throw it (the `toss` state);
a thrown item is its `projectile` (smash throws: `smashProjectile`) launched at the throw's velocity. It turns
into a loose world item when it lands, connects or runs out of life, and a loose item can be picked up on the
ground or caught in the air by anyone.

back.description: The fighter turns around first, so x points the new way.

drop.description: Letting go: grab in the air, or attack / grab from shield.

ItemThrowsPartial.description: Item throw velocities (x forward, y up) by direction and strength.

TossPartial.description: Item throw timing, on the `toss` state clock (0 = the tick the throw starts).

glowWidth.description: Soft glow drawn under the limbs.

eye.description: Eye rectangle `[x, y, w, h]` from the head center (x forward, y up, `(x, y)` = bottom-left corner).

StylePartial.description: Drawing style of the stick figure.

joints.description: Declaration order is stable; parents may appear before or after their children.

bones.description: Stick strokes connecting resolved joint positions.

joints.description:
Local transform overrides for an optional named-joint rig. Missing components inherit from
`from` / `stand`, then the rig's rest transforms. Does not alter combat geometry.

rot.description: Whole-body rotation in degrees, positive = pitching forward, around `(0, pivot)`.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset of the whole figure (up).

PosePartial.description:
Joint positions in fighter-local space (x forward, y up, feet at the origin). A pose may be partial: missing
joints come from `from` (another named pose), or from the `stand` pose.

translation.description: Replaces the rest translation; it is not an additive offset.

angle.description: Replaces the rest angle. Keep angles unwrapped when animating through a full turn.

loop.description: Repeat every this many clock units.

oneOf.description: Frames since the fighter entered the state.
World frame (idle breathing, wobbles).
Run cycle phase in degrees, advanced by ground speed.
Tumble spin in degrees (signed: follows the launch direction).

ClockPartial.description: Time source for a state animation.
